t: Pipulate's Inflection Point: The Cathedral of One in the Age of AI
s: Pipulate is a local-first, AI-augmented digital habitat built on computing sovereignty and radical transparency, featuring a reproducible NixOS environment, WET AI-friendly code, and a novel "Chip O'Theseus" system for AI persistence and memory.
sub: Local-first, AI-augmented digital habitat (Cathedral of One)
NixOS for reproducible environments & FastHTML/HTMX for UI
WET (Write Everything Twice) code for AI readability
Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI agent interaction & "Progressive Reveal"
"Chip O'Theseus" AI persistence: persistent memory, durable backups, and voice restoration
